spans.s:
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Hard, firm.
2 Bound, tied.
mn. (-रः-रं)
The belly.
E.
जम to eat, अर Uṇādi affix, and ठच् substituted for the radical final.

f. (-ला)
Belly-ache, colic, enteritis.
E.
जठर, and ज्वाला burning.

m. (-नुत्)
Cassia fistula.
E.
जठर the belly, and नुद् a laxative.

f. (-णा)
Pain endured by the child before birth.
E.
जठर, and यन्त्रणा punishing; for misdeeds in a preceding birth.

f. (-ना)
Pain of the child in the womb: see the preceding.
E.
जठर, and यातना pain.

f. (-था)
Colic.
E.
जठर, and व्यथा pain.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Being in the belly.
2 Being in the womb.
E.
जठर, and स्थ what stays; also जठरस्थित, and जठरस्थायिन्, &c.

m. (-यः)
Dropsy, water in the abdomen.
E.
जठर the belly, and आमय sickness.
